name: humid_air_1691_economizer_fanless_keeps_ac_run
description: A house with no fan (windows only) keeps its humid-morning window-cooling AC run: no fan, no air pulled in, so the guard does not apply and no 'fan not started' row is written
notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: an economizer guard not gated on a fan existing makes 07:00 read nat_vent_humid_skip and drops the cool-down AC run. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: the room would warm with HVAC paused, and the Activity report would claim a fan that does not exist was refused.

Issue #1507 review: the outdoor humidity is paired with a dedicated outdoor temperature sensor (outdoor_temp_source sensor), as a real install needs for an outdoor dew point, so the coordinator-hosted golden tiers (P8 surfaces, promise parity, real HA) can run this scenario.

events.note: Window cooling with the AC, no fan.

assertions.reason: No fan: the guard does not apply; the cool-down AC run happens as before.
